description: Land Title Settlement Department - Muwanpelessa, Hingurakoda D/S  Division, Hingurakgoda, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120141 and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title claims and registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It involves notices calling for claims to specific land parcels in multiple districts, references to cadastral maps, land ownership determinations, and procedures for land title settlement. The content focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
